<style>
  html{scroll-behavior: smooth;}
</style>
<style>
.pos-yes{color:#1e3a8a;font-weight:700}
.pos-no{color:#b91c1c;font-weight:700}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var container = document.body; // title/excerpt render outside .gh-content, so scope to the whole body
  if (!container || container.dataset.posColored) return;
  container.dataset.posColored = '1';
  var patterns = [
    { re: /(YES\s*\/\s*FOR|Yes\s*\/\s*For)/g, cls: 'pos-yes' },
    { re: /(NO\s*\/\s*AGAINST|No\s*\/\s*Against)/g, cls: 'pos-no' }
  ];
  function wrapIn(parent, node, segs) {
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    segs.forEach(function (s) {
      if (s.cls) {
        var sp = document.createElement('span');
        sp.className = s.cls;
        sp.textContent = s.text;
        frag.appendChild(sp);
      } else {
        frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.text));
      }
    });
    parent.replaceChild(frag, node);
  }
  function processNode(node) {
    var segs = [{ text: node.textContent, cls: null }];
    patterns.forEach(function (p) {
      var next = [];
      segs.forEach(function (s) {
        if (s.cls) { next.push(s); return; }
        var last = 0, m;
        p.re.lastIndex = 0;
        while ((m = p.re.exec(s.text))) {
          if (m.index > last) next.push({ text: s.text.slice(last, m.index), cls: null });
          next.push({ text: m[0], cls: p.cls });
          last = m.index + m[0].length;
        }
        if (last < s.text.length) next.push({ text: s.text.slice(last), cls: null });
      });
      segs = next;
    });
    if (segs.some(function (s) { return s.cls; })) wrapIn(node.parentNode, node, segs);
  }
  var walker = document.createTreeWalker(container, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
    acceptNode: function (n) {
      if (!n.parentNode || n.parentNode.nodeName === 'SCRIPT' || n.parentNode.nodeName === 'STYLE') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
      var p = n.parentNode;
      if (p.nodeName === 'SPAN' && (((p.className || '').indexOf('pos-') === 0) || /color\s*:/.test(p.getAttribute('style') || ''))) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
      return (/YES\s*\/\s*FOR|Yes\s*\/\s*For|NO\s*\/\s*AGAINST|No\s*\/\s*Against/.test(n.textContent)) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
    }
  });
  var nodes = [];
  while (walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
  nodes.forEach(processNode);
})();
</script>
